description: Exicom Tele-Systems Limited manufactures and sells electric vehicle chargers and lithium-ion batteries in India and internationally. It operates through Critical Power and EV Charger segments. The company offers energy storage solutions; switched mode power supply; and switched module rectifier. It also provides DC power conversion systems, hybrid power systems, solar chargers, telecom batteries, controllers, data center battery back-up solutions, and AC and DC chargers. In addition, the company offers Spin Control App; Spin Air and Spin Free app; ChargeX; and Harmony Connect software. It serves CPO, fleet, workplace, hotel, real estate, retail, hospitality, heavy duty vehicle, and hospital industries. The company was formerly known as Himachal Exicom Communications Limited and changed its name to Exicom Tele-Systems Limited in August 2008. The company was incorporated in 1994 and is based in Gurugram, India. Exicom Tele-Systems Limited operates as a subsidiary of NextWave Communications Private Limited.
